study_identification_part.si_4_title: Mapping the Heterogeneous Brain Structural Phenotype of Autism Spectrum Disorder Using the Normative Model

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression (GPR) was used to predict the expected weights of factors.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we developed a normative model by training a Gaussian process regression (GPR) on the ABIDE II TD subjects to predict the expected weights of factors.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.location: Shan2022.pdf.md: METHODS AND MATERIALS / Normative Modeling

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Weights of 6 latent factors obtained from Non-negative Matrix Factorization (NMF) of Gray Matter Volume (GMV) maps.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: These weights were used for normative modeling to estimate the factor deviations.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age and gender were used as covariates in the GPR normative model.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: we developed a normative model by training a GPR on the ABIDE II TD cohort (29), using age and gender as covariates to predict weights
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Shan2022.pdf.md: METHODS AND MATERIALS / Normative Modeling
